delete.summary: Delete menu. Query collectionId when not inferred from path. Editor or owner on collection; menu must belong to collection.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Id of the collection (when not inferred from path).

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid auth headers, or not logged in.

403.description: Forbidden - caller must be editor or owner on the collection; menu must belong to collection.

404.description: Not found - menu or collection does not exist.

code.description: A short, machine-readable error code, for when HTTP status codes are not sufficient.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.
message.example: The requested resource could not be found.
